title: Remove admin-role restrictions blocking rate card upload

requirements.text: Remove admin-only authorization checks that prevent non-admin users from uploading/updating the rate card; any authenticated user must be able to update the master rate card data.

quotes: I can't upload the rate card because of admin rights. Please remove all restricitions.

acceptanceCriteria: A caller that is not an admin can successfully call updateRateCard without receiving an Unauthorized trap.
After updateRateCard succeeds, getRateCard returns the newly uploaded items for that same caller.

requirements.text: Remove admin-only authorization checks for rate-card maintenance operations so they are not restricted by admin role (addRateCardItem, updateRateCardItem, deleteRateCardItem, updateStandardCost).
acceptanceCriteria: A non-admin caller can add, update, and delete individual rate card items via the corresponding backend methods without Unauthorized traps.
A non-admin caller can update standard cost via updateStandardCost without Unauthorized traps, and the updated value is reflected in subsequent getRateCard results.

requirements.text: Remove admin-only authorization checks for account manager maintenance so they are not restricted by admin role (updateAccountManagers, addAccountManager, updateAccountManager, deleteAccountManager).
acceptanceCriteria: A non-admin caller can add/update/delete account managers via the backend without Unauthorized traps.
getAccountManagers reflects the changes after mutations complete.

requirements.text: Ensure the frontend rate card upload flow works end-to-end for non-admin users by handling any remaining authorization errors with clear English messages and confirming the UI refreshes to show the updated rate card after a successful upload.

quotes: I can't upload the rate card because of admin rights.

acceptanceCriteria: Uploading a CSV or XLSX in the Rate Card tab succeeds for a non-admin user and the "Current Rate Card Database" table updates to show the new items.
If an error occurs, the UI displays an English error toast/message that includes the backend error message text.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo.
Do not edit frontend files under frontend/src/components/ui or any other paths listed in frontend immutablePaths.
nonGoals: Do not add third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity is supported).
Do not introduce external databases or additional backend services.
